tickets.title: Prepare adjustable-rate mortgage refinance analysis
tickets.text: Prepare the adjustable-rate mortgage refinance analysis for Dorian Pebblefizz (and Lena Pebblefizz) using the current mortgage balance of $512,400, the current rate of 4.125%, the estimated reset rate of 7.375% and payment increase of about $1,080, and the household cash‑flow gap.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that adjustable-rate mortgage refinance analysis by February 23, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain reset notice and loan documents
tickets.text: Obtain the mortgage reset notice and related loan documents for Dorian Pebblefizz to verify rate‑cap language, index, margin, escrow amount, and timing before finalizing the refinance analysis.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain those reset notice and loan documents by February 20, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete lender quote comparison
tickets.text: Complete a comparison of Teacup Comet Bank’s modification quote with at least two external refinance estimates for Dorian Pebblefizz, including payment amounts, points, estimated cash to close, and escrow treatment.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete the lender quote comparison by March 1, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare concise servicer information request
tickets.text: Prepare a concise written information request for Teacup Comet Bank’s servicer on behalf of Dorian Pebblefizz to obtain the promised modification estimate and clarify the department transfers.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare a concise information request for the servicer by February 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete mortgage escrow discrepancy check
tickets.text: Complete a reconciliation of the escrow amounts shown in the reset notice and the online mortgage portal for Dorian Pebblefizz to resolve the payment difference before relying on the projected post‑reset payment.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to complete the mortgage escrow discrepancy check by February 23, 2024.

tickets.title: Verify recent income and pay statements
tickets.text: Verify Dorian Pebblefizz’s most recent Moonbadger Systems pay statement and Lena Pebblefizz’s Paper Otter Health Cooperative pay statement to ensure current proof of income for the refinance package.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to verify recent income and pay statements by February 21, 2024.

tickets.title: Update household profile
tickets.text: Update the household profile for Dorian Pebblefizz and Lena Pebblefizz with current employment details (Dorian: senior product manager at Moonbadger Systems, $178,000 salary, $24,000 bonus, $18,500 RSU vest; Lena: pediatric occupational therapist at Paper Otter Health Cooperative, $72,000 salary, four‑day workweek), income figures, dependent information (children ages 14 and 11, activity costs $2,400 annually and after‑school care $380 monthly), and family support contributions ($600 monthly to mother Alina Pebblefizz).
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to refresh the household profile with current employment, income, dependent, and family support details by February 29, 2024.

tickets.title: Compare HELOC refinance options
tickets.text: Compare for Dorian Pebblefizz the options of keeping the $74,800 home equity line of credit separate, rolling it into a mortgage refinance, or establishing a scheduled principal repayment plan, considering its 8.9% variable rate, interest‑only payment of $555, and draw period ending November 2025.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to compare keeping it separate, rolling it into a refinance, or using a scheduled principal repayment plan by February 28, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare credit card payoff sequence
tickets.text: Prepare a payoff order for Dorian Pebblefizz’s three credit cards, showing interest costs, minimum‑payment requirements, and the impact of applying the $900 monthly discretionary travel and dining reduction to the highest‑rate card first.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the credit card payoff sequence by February 22, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete credit report balance reconciliation
tickets.text: Complete reconciliation of the credit card balance reported on Dorian Pebblefizz’s credit report, which is about $2,100 higher than the online balance, to ensure accurate debt‑to‑income inputs for the refinance.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete that credit report balance reconciliation by February 27, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare temporary cash‑flow triage budget
tickets.text: Prepare a temporary cash‑flow triage budget for Dorian Pebblefizz that identifies spending reductions, debt‑payment targets, and a minimum cash reserve guardrail, incorporating the $30,000 cash level and the potential $900 monthly reduction in discretionary travel and dining.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare a temporary cash-flow triage budget by February 26, 2024, identifying spending reductions, debt-payment targets, and a minimum cash reserve guardrail.

tickets.title: Prepare bonus and RSU allocation plan
tickets.text: Prepare a written allocation framework for Dorian Pebblefizz’s upcoming $24,000 bonus and $18,500 RSU vesting that balances tax withholding, credit‑card payoff, cash‑reserve protection, and potential refinance closing costs.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the bonus and restricted stock unit allocation plan by March 8, 2024.

tickets.title: Model upcoming equity income for tax adjustments
tickets.text: Model Dorian Pebblefizz’s upcoming equity income from the $18,500 RSU vesting to estimate potential tax liability and determine if additional withholding is needed, given his concern that RSU withholding may be below his marginal tax rate.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to model the upcoming equity income for possible estimated tax or withholding adjustments by March 15, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete insurance premium pressure review
tickets.text: Complete a review of the homeowners insurance renewal for Dorian Pebblefizz, examining coverage pages, deductible options, and whether the escrow projection reflects the increased premium from $2,480 to $3,190 annually.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete the insurance premium pressure review by March 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete estate document relevance check
tickets.text: Complete a review of Dorian Pebblefizz and Lena Pebblefizz’s estate documents, including wills and beneficiary designations, to identify updates needed for Alina Pebblefizz support and current debt considerations, to discuss with their attorney.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete the estate document relevance check by March 12, 2024.
